answer.sameness: The set uses several repeated layout families: atelje-bergant and urarstvo-tic share a mostly empty white desktop hero, upper-right introduction, oversized lower-left headline and tinted address strip; kolesarski-servis-ovinek and vinarstvo-pinteric share a panoramic photograph above a dark headline-and-contact band; sirarna-pr-simnu and steklarstvo-vrhovnik use left-hand copy beside a large right-hand photograph. Heavy rounded serifs recur across the watchmaker, brewery, cheesemaker and winery, while condensed uppercase lettering links the bicycle and glass businesses. Small wordmark headers, tiny navigation, rectangular phone buttons and location labels recur throughout. On phones, much of
recurringIssues: Mobile contact bars and floating buttons overlap content or compete with existing calls to action on several pages.
Oversized mobile headlines produce awkward, fragmented wrapping, particularly on the glass, bicycle and winery pages.
Desktop navigation and supporting text are frequently too small relative to the dominant headlines.
Several desktop compositions rely on large empty areas rather than business-specific visual substance.
Photography often functions as a single illustrative product crop rather than establishing a distinctive place, team or customer experience.

best.why: The restrained mint-and-dark-teal palette, elegant serif headline and neatly framed product photograph form the most coherent identity across desktop and phone.
The generous cheese photograph, burgundy header and headline overlapping the image create a convincing product-led composition with a clear mobile sequence.
The mustard field, substantial serif typography and offset ingredient photograph give this business a memorable character rather than another white split-screen.

weakest.why: An isolated headline, contact table and large blank desktop area make this feel like an administrative information page rather than a designed introduction to a dance school.
The mobile headline becomes a punishing stack of condensed capitals, while floating contact controls intrude into the supporting content.
The generic grape-led composition closely repeats the bicycle page's structure, and the oversized mobile headline breaks into an ungainly narrow stack.

answer.oneChange: Replace reusable hero formulas with a business-specific art-direction stage: establish each homepage's defining visual idea, imagery and desktop/mobile composition before applying shared interface components.
answer.summary: This is competent template-shop work with several attractive identities, not yet a consistently distinctive studio portfolio. Colour and type provide useful differentiation, but paired layouts reveal the underlying formulas. Optika Jasna, Sirarna Pr' Šimnu and Pivovarna Rov show the strongest direction. The main weaknesses are sparse desktop compositions, oversized mobile headlines and contact controls that crowd content. Keep the practical contact emphasis, but give each business a stronger visual premise and test the complete first screen on phones rather than merely stacking desktop elements.
